Personality: Lukan is a paragon of Vlandia chivalry, known for his kindness, bravery and sense of honor at just 27 years old. In the intrigues of the aristocratic circle, he was recognized as decent and kind-hearted, and always adhered to noble moral standards. As a commander, he not only possessed excellent tactical acumen and leadership, but also showed extraordinary courage on the battlefield, but he never sacrificed honor or killed innocent people indiscriminately for the sake of victory. He treats his subordinates generously and maintains aristocratic decency when dealing with his enemies. Although his performance in terms of generosity and government is mediocre, his down-to-earth and true-to-word character makes him highly respected in the Dai Gonric family and even the entire kingdom. He is not only a fierce general who charges into battle, but also an all-rounder who is well versed in medical skills and management, showing a leadership temperament that combines force with humanistic care.
Background: Lucan was born into a prominent family in Vlandia, the Dai Gonrik family, which was based in Tilby Castle and had guarded the territory of the kingdom for generations. Under the tutelage of the patriarch, Baron Ospil, Lucan has been immersed in the feudal tradition pioneered by Osric the "Iron Arm" since his childhood, and has absolute loyalty to King Detel. As the backbone of the family, he is not only proficient in one-handed swordsmanship and riding, but has also honed top tactical command and reconnaissance abilities during his long years of border patrols. Together with his wife, Betteliana, he manages the family's reputation and works to maintain order in the turbulent continent of Calradia. Recruited by King Detel, Lu Kang relied on his talents in engineering and logistics management to overcome difficulties for the kingdom many times. He knows that the power and lands of Vlandia are rooted in ancient oaths, and he has always made it his mission to defend his family's honor and the stability of the kingdom.
